\section*{AP \({ }^{\text {® }}\) CALCULUS BC \\ 2012 SCORING GUIDELINES}

\section*{Question 3}

Let \(f\) be the continuous function defined on [-4, 3] whose graph, consisting of three line segments and a semicircle centered at the origin, is given above. Let \(g\) be the function given by \(g(x)=\int_{1}^{x} f(t) d t\).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Find the values of \(g(2)\) and \(g(-2)\).
\item[(b)] For each of \(g^{\prime}(-3)\) and \(g^{\prime \prime}(-3)\), find the value or state that it does not exist.
\item[(c)] Find the \(x\)-coordinate of each point at which the graph of \(g\) has a horizontal tangent line. For each of these points, determine whether \(g\) has a relative minimum, relative maximum, or neither a minimum nor a maximum at the point. Justify your answers.
\item[(d)] For \(-4<x<3\), find all values of \(x\) for which the graph of \(g\) has a point of inflection. Explain your reasoning.
\item[(a)] \(g(2)=\int_{1}^{2} f(t) d t=-\frac{1}{2}(1)\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)=-\frac{1}{4}\)
\[
\begin{aligned}
g(-2) & =\int_{1}^{-2} f(t) d t=-\int_{-2}^{1} f(t) d t \\
& =-\left(\frac{3}{2}-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{3}{2}
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(b)] \(g^{\prime}(x)=f(x) \Rightarrow g^{\prime}(-3)=f(-3)=2\)
\[
g^{\prime \prime}(x)=f^{\prime}(x) \Rightarrow g^{\prime \prime}(-3)=f^{\prime}(-3)=1
\]
\item[(c)] The graph of \(g\) has a horizontal tangent line where \(g^{\prime}(x)=f(x)=0\). This occurs at \(x=-1\) and \(x=1\). \(g^{\prime}(x)\) changes sign from positive to negative at \(x=-1\). Therefore, \(g\) has a relative maximum at \(x=-1\). \(g^{\prime}(x)\) does not change sign at \(x=1\). Therefore, \(g\) has neither a relative maximum nor a relative minimum at \(x=1\).
\item[(d)] The graph of \(g\) has a point of inflection at each of \(x=-2, x=0\), and \(x=1\) because \(g^{\prime \prime}(x)=f^{\prime}(x)\) changes sign at each of these values.
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: g(2) \\ 1: g(-2)\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: g^{\prime}(-3) \\ 1: g^{\prime \prime}(-3)\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(3:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \operatorname{considers} g^{\prime}(x)=0 \\ 1: x=-1 \text { and } x=1 \\ 1: \text { answers with justifications }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { answer } \\ 1: \text { explanation }\end{array}\right.\)
\end{itemize}
